name: Pinner Wire & Cable, Inc.
old_description: Garland, Texas manufacturer of custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses, operating for over 30 years as an SDVOSB-certified supplier.
about:
Pinner Wire & Cable, Inc. is based in Garland, Texas, and was founded in 1991. The company operates as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB).

The company manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and molded assemblies. It offers custom assembly design from prints, drawings, schematics, or prototypes, and maintains UL/CSA approved manufacturing processes.

The firm supplies custom wire and cable assemblies to clients that require SDVOSB-certified sources, including government and prime contractor programs.
